user.title: Reap
user.description:
Reap what you Sow.

Choose where tasks go and a starting point for your frost dates. You can adjust the dates on the next page.

data_description.todo_entity: Pick an existing to-do list, or let the planner create its own.
data_description.zone: Hardiness zones only roughly predict frost dates, so check them against local averages on the next page.

location.title: Frost dates and greenhouse
location.description: Crop timings are stored as days before or after your frost dates.

data.harden_off_days: Days to harden off before planting in beds
data.greenhouse_harden_off_days: Days to harden off before planting in the greenhouse
data.lookahead_days: Add tasks to the list this many days ahead
data.warm_last_frost: Last frost for warm crops (MM-DD, optional)

data_description.lookahead_days: Tasks further out stay in the planner until they come into view, so long succession sowings don't flood the list.
data_description.last_frost: Average date of the last frost in spring.
data_description.first_frost: Average date of the first frost in fall.
data_description.warm_last_frost: Tomatoes, peppers, squash and other frost-tender crops are timed from this date instead. Set it later than your last frost where spring stays cool for weeks afterwards. Leave empty to use the last frost.
data_description.offset_days: Negative for earlier, positive for later. Use this to fine-tune for a warm or cold garden.
data_description.profile: How quickly spring warms up after your last frost. This changes how early hardy crops go in and how long warm crops wait.

error.cannot_schedule: That crop can't be planned that way. Check the method, season and dates.

planting_details.title: {crop}
planting_details.description: How and when to grow it. The fields start with this crop's defaults. Leave the optional ones empty to use the crop's usual window.

data.save_defaults: Save as the default for this crop

data_description.start_date: Transplant date for indoor starts, or first sowing date for direct sowing. Empty means the start of the crop's window.
data_description.succession_days: Sow again every this many days. 0 means a single sowing.
data_description.succession_until: Last date for a repeat sowing. Empty means the end of the crop's window.
data_description.variety: Shown in task names, for example Sungold.
data_description.save_defaults: Next time you add this crop, the method, repeat interval, number of sowings, quantity and location start with these values.

add_crop.title: Add a crop or variety
add_crop.description: Enter the dates you'd usually do each step in your garden, using the ones that apply. The year doesn't matter. To add a variety, copy timing from the crop it's a variety of and leave the dates empty.

key.description: Lowercase id, for example tomato_sungold. Using a built-in key overrides that crop.

based_on.name: Based on
based_on.description: Copy windows and defaults from this crop, then apply the other fields.

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: List of windows with a season and ranges for indoor, direct, transplant and cover. Each range is two dates, either MM-DD for your garden or offsets like L-14 (14 days before last frost) and F+7 (7 days after first frost).

days_to_harvest.name: Days to harvest
days_to_harvest.description: From sowing, or planting for garlic and potatoes.

pot_up.name: Pot up
pot_up.description: Add a pot-up task for indoor starts.

icon.name: Icon

sync.name: Sync

set_crop_defaults.description: Set what a new planting of a crop starts with.
